item.title: Codex scraped the ICM website and discovered 2026 Fields Medal winner list
item.description:
📝 The list of 2026 Fields Medal winners has been inadvertently leaked, revealing that Peking University alumni Hong Wang and Yu Deng are among the recipients. A curl command generated by Codex revealed the names Yu Deng, John Pardon, Jacob Tsimerman, and Hong Wang. Notably, Hong Wang will become the third female mathematician in history to receive the Fields Medal, further highlighting the groundbreaking nature of this achievement.
🔗 Read more: https://phemex.com/news/article/2026-fields-medal-winners-list-leaked-includes-two-peking-university-alumni-92948
